senses.example: Bebo mucha agua todos los días.
senses.exampleGloss: I drink a lot of water every day.

alternatives.reason: A common bar order, the fizzy version.
How it is usually ordered at a bar.

notes: Feminine noun that takes el in the singular: el agua, but el agua fría. Taught with the definite article el as the corpus does for stressed a- nouns.
